preconditions.description: The total weight n of the path is between 1 and 100 inclusive.
Each vertex has exactly k children, where k is between 1 and 100 inclusive.
The minimum weight d of the required edge is between 1 and k inclusive.

postconditions.description: The number of valid paths modulo 1000000007 is a non-negative integer less than 1000000007.

postconditions.expression: return_value == sum(1 for path in all_paths if sum(path) == n and any(weight >= d for weight in path)) % 1000000007
postconditions.description: The return value is the count of all paths starting from the root with total weight n that include at least one edge of weight at least d, modulo 1000000007.
